first_attempt.failure: Two mathematically identical exact-adjoint calls returned microscopically different visible counts because CUDA backward accumulation is atomic and not bitwise deterministic; an absolute 1e-6 equality guard rejected the run.

correction.operator: Concatenate raw-positive, raw-negative, c*q, and c*(1-q) into one four-channel source raster and execute one exact raster adjoint; split its single registered_sum and reuse its single support_count.
correction.semantic_equivalence: The linear adjoint of a channel concatenation equals concatenating the adjoints of the channels; the corrected implementation changes neither the registered probability, reliability, field fusion, threshold, nor benchmark protocol.
correction.runtime_effect: one exact-adjoint call instead of two, so lower runtime and one shared visibility authority
